name: Material link (a hair, a drop of blood, a personal item)

description.value:
The 'get me something of hers' driver - a hair or a heirloom that ties a Scry or Teleport to its target. Named/greater links are legwork.

  • Item Tier: T3
  • Availability: 3
  • Cost: ¥2,500
  • Profile: Consumed in casting. The Shadowrun staple tying a Scry or Teleport-Circle to its target. Named/greater links (a signature possession, a body part) are the T2-T1 grade. | Grade/cost scales with Ritual Tier (Rituals appendix B2 authoritative). Tags: Ritual, Consumable, Scry
  • Tags: Ritual, Consumable, Scry

Item Tier sets price, Availability, and mod-slot count only — never raw power.
